name: Epilude OG social card — wordmark-only dark canvas by Epilude Notetaker
description: A 1200×630 social card that bets everything on a single centered lockup: a near-black canvas with no headline, tagline or product shot. The mark is a run of thin diagonal strokes that gain weight and terminate in a solid block, butted flush against a heavy all-caps italic wordmark in off-white, so the mark reads as acceleration into the name. Two values only — charcoal ground, bone-white type — and roughly 60% empty canvas make it survive being shrunk into a Slack or X preview.
